comments: Listed in the group of Phya pa (ID:3831)'s students called "the four wise ones" (shes rab can mi bzhi), comprising 'Gar dBang grub (ID:3851), Khong po 'Jag chung (ID:3852), lHo pa sGog zan (ID:3853), and sPar phu ba (ID:3854). He is however not listed among the "three wise ones" (shes rab can mi gsum) by gSer mdog Paṇ chen ([VKBZTBWN]: 5a1).
